milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-AUT2 autonomy hardening: UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor durable daemon, narrow launcher and activation self-check
milestoneContract.objective: Make the repository-native supervisor the primary unattended executor through Windows Task Scheduler -> narrow launcher -> durable loop that waits in a WAITING state for the nearest provider retry, dependency event, queued job or heartbeat, survives the Claude app closing, needs no routine, restarts safely, never duplicates commits or review cycles after a reboot, keeps Founder decisions and signer waits scoped to their lanes, and exposes an activation self-check, within the Founder's autonomy-hardening permission and without weakening any trust control. Per the Founder directive of 2026-09-30 the supervisor also maintains the passive status artifact .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json from its own read-only discovery, and the Claude app routine becomes a passive display that runs no command.

acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The daemon runs one shared tick per iteration only while its control-plane trust root verifies and Global Stop is inactive, holds the single process lock for its whole life, sleeps in WAITING until the nearest of ready work, provider retryAfter, package/release notBefore or the periodic heartbeat (bounded by maxSleep, Founder-pending items never wake it), wakes early on the wake file or Global Stop without its own heartbeat writes waking it, writes an atomic heartbeat and exits 0 on a clean stop, 2 on a fatal trust/configuration error and 3 when another worker holds the lock.

The launcher starts only the fixed daemon command without a shell, restarts crashes with bounded backoff and an hourly limit, and does not restart clean stops, fatal errors or an already-running worker; the scheduled task UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor runs the launcher at logon and on a periodic heartbeat, single instance, unlimited, restart on failure, user level, never stores a password, adds a startup trigger only for an elevated S4U registration, and refuses to overwrite another program's task of the same name.

Tests A-K and the lifecycle test pass with real processes: the supervisor outlives the process that started it, runs with every routine disabled, persists a provider quota across a restart and resumes without consuming a cycle, backs off and recovers from a failing Claude CLI without partial commits, yields one worker on duplicate launch, adopts a committed builder round and a completed review after a reboot without a second call, commit or cycle, unlocks dependents on CLEAN, enters remediation on BLOCKED, blocks only the Founder-pending lane and only the signing lane when the signer is unavailable, fails closed on unknown commands, and the launcher restarts a crashed daemon.

The activation self-check reports the daemon policy, durable queue and transition log, live heartbeat, single-worker lock enforced by the running daemon, builder boundary, provider CLI resolution and, only with --with-provider-smoke, a real builder and reviewer invocation through the production brokers (otherwise NOT_TESTED, never PASS), without changing the queue.

Phase0 runs install.ps1 -SkipAutoStart and registers the installed system's autostart under its own task name; git command contracts run with the repository git isolation; no existing test, validator or policy is weakened and only the listed protected files change, with the trust root resealed in the same commit.

The supervisor writes .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json atomically with every heartbeat and single tick, containing supervisor status, heartbeat, current master, active package, implementation and review queue counts, blocked lanes, Codex quota/retry, signer, Phase0, last successful action, next scheduled action, current Founder decisions and an overall health derived only from real signals (an unknown or stale heartbeat or a broken transition log is never healthy; Global Stop is STOPPED).

The supervisor performs the discovery itself through read-only exact contracts (default-branch and branch heads, git worktree list, a fixed scheduled-task state query limited to the two policy task names) plus the verified transition log and provider state; a failed probe is reported as UNAVAILABLE and a status write failure never blocks execution.
Nothing in the supervisor depends on the Claude app routine, which only reads the status artifact; a wake request that arrives while a tick runs or while the status is written is not lost.
mandatoryFailureCases: a daemon iteration that acts without a verified trust root or during Global Stop
two workers running at the same time
a provider called before its retryAfter or a quota consuming a review cycle
a second builder call, commit or review cycle after a crash
a Founder decision or signer wait blocking unrelated lanes
the launcher running anything other than the fixed daemon command
the installed system's autostart replacing the supervisor task
invocation checks reported PASS without a real invocation
a stale or unknown heartbeat or a broken transition log reported as healthy
a scheduled-task query for a task name outside the policy
a wake request lost while the status is written
the supervisor depending on the Claude app routine
